rules.title: Left-hand drive (LHD) only
rules.rule_text: The UAE registers left-hand-drive vehicles only. Right-hand-drive vehicles are generally not permitted for private registration unless converted to LHD.

rules.title: No general age limit
rules.rule_text: There is no universal age limit for importing used cars into the UAE, but vehicles must meet GCC specification and older vehicles may require additional approval in some emirates. Confirm with official customs before trading.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with official authorities before purchase.

rules.title: GCC specification required
rules.rule_text: Imported vehicles should conform to GCC (Gulf Cooperation Council) specification. Non-GCC-specification vehicles may require modification before registration.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with official authorities before purchase.

rules.title: EV incentives
rules.rule_text: The UAE offers incentives for electric vehicles including public charging programs and toll exemptions in some emirates. Confirm current EV import requirements with official customs before trading.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with official authorities before purchase.

rules.title: Left-hand drive (LHD) only
rules.rule_text: Saudi Arabia is a left-hand-drive market. Vehicles must be LHD to be registered.

rules.title: Used passenger car age limit (5 years)
rules.rule_text: Saudi Arabia generally restricts import of used passenger cars to those no older than five years; heavy vehicles may have different limits. Confirm with official customs before trading.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with official authorities before purchase.

rules.title: SABER / SASO conformity
rules.rule_text: Imported vehicles require SASO conformity and registration on the SABER platform before shipment.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with official authorities before purchase.

rules.title: EV adoption incentives
rules.rule_text: Saudi Arabia is promoting EV adoption through charging infrastructure and fee exemptions. Confirm current EV import rules with official customs before trading.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with official authorities before purchase.

rules.title: Right-hand drive (RHD) only
rules.rule_text: Kenya is a right-hand-drive market. Vehicles must be RHD to be registered under KS 1515.

rules.title: 8-year age limit
rules.rule_text: Kenya limits import of used motor vehicles to those not older than eight years, enforced under KS 1515:2000. Confirm the exact cut-off with official customs (KRA/KEBS) before trading.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with official authorities before purchase.

rules.title: Pre-shipment inspection (PVoC)
rules.rule_text: Used vehicles require a Pre-Export Verification of Conformity (PVoC) certificate before export to Kenya.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with official authorities before purchase.

rules.title: EV duty relief
rules.rule_text: Kenya applies a reduced import duty and exempts electric vehicles from excise duty under the EAC Common External Tariff. Confirm current rates with official customs before trading.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with official authorities before purchase.

rules.title: Right-hand drive (RHD) only
rules.rule_text: Tanzania is a right-hand-drive market. Vehicles must be RHD to be registered.

rules.title: Age limit (about 8-10 years)
rules.rule_text: Tanzania restricts import of used vehicles by age, commonly around eight to ten years. Confirm the current limit with official customs (TRA) before trading.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with official authorities before purchase.

rules.title: Pre-shipment inspection (PVoC)
rules.rule_text: Used vehicles require a Pre-shipment Verification of Conformity (PVoC) through the Tanzania Bureau of Standards before import.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with official authorities before purchase.

rules.title: EV incentives
rules.rule_text: Tanzania has introduced incentives to encourage EV imports, including reduced excise on electric vehicles. Confirm current policy with official authorities before trading.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with official authorities before purchase.

rules.title: Right-hand drive (RHD) only
rules.rule_text: Nigeria is a right-hand-drive market. Left-hand-drive vehicles are generally not permitted for registration.

rules.title: Vehicle age restriction
rules.rule_text: Nigeria restricts import of used vehicles by age, and the rules have changed in recent years. Confirm current limits with official customs (Nigeria Customs Service) before trading.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with official authorities before purchase.

rules.title: Pre-shipment inspection (SONCAP / Form M)
rules.rule_text: Used vehicles are subject to Nigeria's import clearance and pre-shipment inspection requirements (SONCAP / Form M). Confirm current procedure with official customs before trading.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with official authorities before purchase.

rules.title: EV policy developing
rules.rule_text: Nigeria's EV import policy is developing, with discussion of duty relief for electric vehicles. Confirm current rules with official customs before trading.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with official authorities before purchase.

rules.title: Left-hand drive (LHD) only
rules.rule_text: Kazakhstan is a left-hand-drive market. Right-hand-drive vehicles are generally not permitted.

rules.title: Vehicle age limit (recently adjusted)
rules.rule_text: Kazakhstan applies an age limit to imported used vehicles, which has been adjusted in recent years. Confirm the current limit with official customs before trading.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with official authorities before purchase.

rules.title: EAEU technical regulations
rules.rule_text: Imported vehicles must comply with EAEU (Eurasian Economic Union) technical regulations and certification.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with official authorities before purchase.

rules.title: EV duty exemption
rules.rule_text: Kazakhstan has temporarily exempted electric vehicles from customs duty and recycling fee to promote adoption. Confirm current status with official customs before trading.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with official authorities before purchase.

rules.title: Left-hand drive (LHD) only
rules.rule_text: Uzbekistan is a left-hand-drive market. Vehicles must be LHD to be registered.

rules.title: Strict import controls
rules.rule_text: Uzbekistan applies strict controls on vehicle imports, including certification and recycling fees. Confirm current requirements with official customs before trading.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with official authorities before purchase.

rules.title: Vehicle age restrictions
rules.rule_text: Uzbekistan has historically restricted used vehicle imports by age. Confirm current limits with official customs before trading.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with official authorities before purchase.

rules.title: EV import duty & excise exemption
rules.rule_text: Uzbekistan exempts electric vehicles from import duty and excise tax to encourage adoption. Confirm current rates with official customs before trading.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with official authorities before purchase.

rules.title: Right-hand drive (RHD) only
rules.rule_text: South Africa drives on the left and registers right-hand-drive (RHD) vehicles. Left-hand-drive vehicles are generally not registrable for private use.

rules.title: ITAC import permit required
rules.rule_text: Used/second-hand vehicles may only be imported with an International Trade Administration Commission (ITAC) import permit. Permits are restricted mainly to returning South African nationals, permanent-residence immigrants, racing cars, vintage, specially designed and inherited vehicles.

rules.title: NRCS Letter of Authority + Interpol clearance
rules.rule_text: SARS requires, for a second-hand vehicle import to be legal: customs clearance documents, a Letter of Authority from the National Regulator for Compulsory Specifications (NRCS), an ITAC import permit, and an Interpol clearance certificate.

rules.title: No fixed age limit (restricted categories)
rules.rule_text: South Africa has no hard age cut-off for used vehicles, but imports are restricted to defined permit categories (returning residents, immigrants, special-purpose vehicles). Confirm current ITAC permit eligibility before sourcing stock.
rules.notes: Permit categories are restrictive — verify eligibility with ITAC before purchase.

rules.title: EVs face 25% import duty (no relief)
rules.rule_text: Electric vehicles attract the same 25% passenger-vehicle import duty (higher than the 18% ICE rate in some classifications); there is no EV-specific import-duty relief in South Africa.
rules.notes: Confirm current HS 87 duty classification with SARS before purchase.

rules.title: Left-hand drive (LHD) only
rules.rule_text: Egypt drives on the right and registers left-hand-drive (LHD) vehicles. Right-hand-drive vehicles are not registrable — typical RHD Japanese used cars cannot be imported or registered.

rules.title: Used cars near-new (about 1 year); EVs up to 3 years
rules.rule_text: Egypt restricts used passenger-car imports to near-new units (about one year old), while electric vehicles up to three years old are permitted under the 2025 EV policy.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with Egyptian Customs before purchase.

rules.title: NAFEZA single-window clearance
rules.rule_text: All vehicle shipments must clear through the NAFEZA single-window system; import licence, certificate of conformity and proof of payment via authorised banks are required.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with Egyptian Customs before purchase.

rules.title: EV import duty exemption (0%)
rules.rule_text: From 1 January 2025 Egypt exempts pure-electric vehicles (BEV, HS 8703.80) from customs duty (0%), with a progressive FOB-value deduction up to 50%. Individuals may import one EV every five years.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with Egyptian Customs before purchase.

rules.title: Left-hand drive (LHD) only
rules.rule_text: Jordan drives on the right and registers left-hand-drive (LHD) vehicles.

rules.title: EV age cap of 3 years
rules.rule_text: Under rules effective 1 November 2025, electric vehicles more than three years old (including the year of customs clearance) may no longer be imported.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with Jordan Customs before purchase.

rules.title: Salvage / damaged vehicles banned
rules.rule_text: Vehicles classified as salvage or junk — including fire-, flood-damaged or unrepairable units — may no longer be imported into Jordan.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with Jordan Customs before purchase.

rules.title: EV special tax unified at 27%
rules.rule_text: Under the 2025 Special Tax Bylaw (announced 28 June 2025), special tax on electric vehicles is unified at 27% for all categories, versus 51% for petrol and 39% for hybrid vehicles.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with Jordan Customs before purchase.

rules.title: Right-hand drive (RHD) only
rules.rule_text: Pakistan drives on the left and registers right-hand-drive (RHD) vehicles.

rules.title: Cars up to 3 years (personal schemes)
rules.rule_text: Under the Personal Baggage, Gift and Transfer of Residence schemes, used cars not older than 3 years and other vehicles not older than 5 years may be imported. The commercial-channel 5-year age cap was removed from 1 July 2026 (SRO 1065/2026).
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with FBR before purchase.

rules.title: Personal Baggage / Gift / Transfer of Residence schemes
rules.rule_text: Used vehicles are imported by overseas Pakistanis under the Personal Baggage, Gift or Transfer of Residence schemes only; duty is a fixed US-dollar schedule by engine capacity (e.g. US$13,200 for 1001–1300cc).
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with FBR before purchase.

rules.title: EV duty concession (25% up to US$50k)
rules.rule_text: Electric 4-wheelers valued up to US$50,000 are taxed at 25% customs duty; hybrid electric vehicles up to 1800cc receive a 50% duty exemption (25% for 1800–2500cc).
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with FBR before purchase.

rules.title: Right-hand drive (RHD) only
rules.rule_text: Bangladesh drives on the left and registers right-hand-drive (RHD) vehicles.

rules.title: Reconditioned-car age restrictions
rules.rule_text: Bangladesh imports reconditioned (used) vehicles under NBR rules with age and condition restrictions; duty is a compounding cascade of customs duty, supplementary duty, VAT, advance income tax and regulatory duty.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with NBR before purchase.

rules.title: Pre-export inspection required
rules.rule_text: Reconditioned vehicle imports require pre-export inspection and standard documentation (invoice, bill of lading, certificate of origin).
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with NBR before purchase.

rules.title: PHEV / EV duty reduction
rules.rule_text: Bangladesh has proposed import-duty cuts on plug-in hybrid electric vehicles as part of its energy-efficiency strategy; EV/PHEV duty treatment is evolving.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with NBR before purchase.

rules.title: Left-hand drive (LHD) only
rules.rule_text: Chile drives on the right and registers left-hand-drive (LHD) vehicles.

rules.title: No import age limit
rules.rule_text: Chile has no import age limit for used vehicles, making it one of the most flexible markets in Latin America.
rules.notes: Confirm current SNA customs rules before ordering used units.

rules.title: RUT + standard documents
rules.rule_text: A Chilean tax identification number (RUT) is required; clearance needs the invoice, bill of lading, certificate of origin and export certificate.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with Chile Customs before purchase.

rules.title: No EV-specific duty relief
rules.rule_text: Chile applies a flat 6% ad valorem duty regardless of powertrain; no EV-specific import-duty relief is recorded. Chinese EVs have strong market presence.
rules.notes: Uncertain / changes frequently — verify with Chile Customs before purchase.
